title: Kubernetes v1.37 引入节点生命周期条件
english: Kubernetes v1.37 introduces five well-known Node conditions to provide a shared, Kubernetes-owned description of node lifecycle activity. The conditions are DrainInProgress, Drained, MaintenancePlanned, MaintenanceInProgress, and GracefulNodeShutdownInProgress. Previously, node state was described across readiness, taints, Pod state, labels, annotations, and provider-specific APIs, with no common condition for draining, maintenance, or graceful node shutdown. These conditions create a clearer lifecycle vocabulary for Kubernetes nodes.
chinese: Kubernetes v1.37 新增五个标准化 Node conditions，用于描述节点排空、已排空、计划维护、维护中以及优雅节点关机进行中。此前，节点状态分散在 Readiness、taint、Pod 状态、标签、注解和云厂商特定 API 中，缺少由 Kubernetes 统一定义的生命周期表达。
why_it_matters: 对云原生与 AIOps 而言，统一的节点生命周期信号有助于将排空、维护和优雅关机纳入可观测性、自动化编排与告警规则。面向 Agent Infra，这也为自动化代理理解节点当前操作状态提供了明确、共享的语义，而不必只依赖分散的间接信号。
interview_expression: Kubernetes v1.37 adds shared Node conditions for draining, maintenance, and graceful node shutdown. I would use these standardized signals when designing observability and automation workflows for node lifecycle operations.

vocabulary.meaning: 节点条件；用于表达节点状态的标准化字段
vocabulary.example: The new Node conditions describe lifecycle activity on a Kubernetes node.

vocabulary.meaning: 节点排空；将工作负载从节点迁移或驱逐的过程
vocabulary.example: DrainInProgress indicates that a node is draining.

vocabulary.meaning: 优雅节点关机；在关机过程中有序处理工作负载的机制
vocabulary.example: GracefulNodeShutdownInProgress describes a graceful node shutdown in progress.

sources.title: Kubernetes v1.37: Introducing Node Lifecycle Conditions
sources.summary:
Kubernetes has many ways to describe what is happening on a Node. Readiness, taints, Pod state, labels, annotations, and provider-specific APIs each expose part of the picture. What has been missing is a shared, Kubernetes-owned way to say that a Node is draining, undergoing maintenance, or undergoing Graceful Node Shutdown.

Kubernetes v1.37 introduces five well-known Node conditions that provide that description:

  • DrainInProgress
  • Drained
  • MaintenancePlanned
  • MaintenanceInProgress
  • GracefulNodeShutdownInProgress
